name: Seedr transfers
description: Runs magnets and torrent files as transfers on a Seedr account.

codes.seedr_jobs.address_unsupported: Seedr transfers take a magnet address or a torrent file, not a web address
codes.seedr_jobs.auth_invalid: Seedr rejected this account's e-mail address or password. Enter them again.
codes.seedr_jobs.no_files: Seedr reports this transfer as finished but its folder holds no files
codes.seedr_jobs.no_selection: Seedr downloads the whole transfer and has no file selection
codes.seedr_jobs.no_transfer_id: Seedr did not name the transfer it created. Check your Seedr account before trying again.
codes.seedr_jobs.not_a_torrent: Seedr takes a magnet address or a torrent file, and this is neither
codes.seedr_jobs.out_of_space: The Seedr account has no space left for this transfer. Waiting.
codes.seedr_jobs.plan_required: The Seedr REST API needs a premium plan on this account
codes.seedr_jobs.rate_limited: The Seedr request limit was reached. Waiting.
codes.seedr_jobs.transfer_gone: Seedr no longer holds this transfer
